verdict.rationale:
SumUp provides dedicated sandbox merchant accounts, test cards, and simulated payment flows (success/failure/3DS) explicitly for testing without touching production data, and even a Virtual Solo device for testing terminal flows before switching to physical hardware. This directly satisfies an AI-native user's need to test integrations safely.

missing for 10: explicit confirmation that AI-agent-driven tools (MCP server/agent toolkit) themselves operate against the sandbox environment, and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs.
